question: A collection of related web pages is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**website**__.

__
 
• Collections of many web pages are called **websites**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• It can also be said that a **website** or site is a location where a lot of **web pages are kept**.
 
• It is a place connected to the **Internet** where information about an** organization is available**.
 
• The World Wide Web (www) which is a part of the Internet consists of websites.
 
• A website is a book printed on the Internet, through which information can be given about something or some goods or services can be sold.
